## Vault.cachedRead() method

Read the content of a plaintext file stored inside the vault Use this if you only want to display the content to the user. If you want to modify the file content afterward use [Vault.read()](docs/obsidian_docs/obsidian_dev_docs/en/Reference/TypeScript%20API/Vault/read.md)

 0.9.7
